bash.description: Run bash -c; return stdout/stderr and [exit code: N]. Check exit codes and investigate failures. Each call uses a fresh shell. Project tools run without desktop windows: use the supplied Godot/browser launchers and return artifacts for user preview. Truncated output reports its saved file. A sandbox denial permits one exact retry with exposed sandbox_permissions and justification through approval, only if approvals are enabled. Never bypass a denial or rejected escalation. Escalate only after this access was denied; unrelated commands may continue. Managed environment facts are in $DSH_*.

parameters.description: Brief action shown in the UI.
parameters.timeoutMs: Milliseconds; configured default/cap; expiry kills the command.
parameters.workdir: Default current working directory; relative paths resolve from it.
parameters.run_in_background: For long work: return job id, collect via job_output, stop via job_kill; no timeout. When the next step depends on completion, use wait with a job condition, then read the result; no sleep polling.
parameters.sandbox_permissions: Exact denied-operation retry only, with justification and user approval.
parameters.justification: Why this exact operation needs wider access.

read.description: Inspect UTF-8 text with line numbers; use offset/limit for large files.

write.description: Create or replace UTF-8 text. Read an existing file first; use edit for targeted changes.

parameters.sandbox_permissions: Exact denied-operation retry only, with justification and user approval.
parameters.justification: Why this exact operation needs wider access.

edit.description: Replace literal UTF-8 text. Read first unless just created/edited. old_string must match once unless replace_all; empty new_string deletes it.

parameters.sandbox_permissions: Exact denied-operation retry only, with justification and user approval.
parameters.justification: Why this exact operation needs wider access.

glob.description: Find files by glob, including hidden/ignored files except VCS metadata. Returns up to 100 paths, newest first; capped results report a saved full list. Files only.

parameters.pattern: Without /, matches basenames at any depth; include / to anchor depth.
parameters.path: Default current working directory; relative paths resolve from it.

grep.description: Search contents by ripgrep regex; return up to 250 matching lines with file/line numbers. Capped results report a saved full list; read for surrounding context.

parameters.path: File or directory; default session workspace; relative paths resolve from it.
parameters.include: One glob, such as *.{js,jsx}; no list or negation.

read_image.description: Return PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF pixels; requires image-capable model. Detects format without extension and downscales large images automatically. Read independent images in small batches.

job_output.description: Read job output. Streams return new output; final-output jobs return after settlement. Check [status: ...]. Non-blocking unless wait=true; timeout leaves the job running. For completion dependencies use wait with a job condition; read intermediate output only when it changes a decision.

parameters.timeout_ms: Milliseconds for wait=true; configured default and cap.

job_list.description: List your background job ids, kinds and statuses.

job_kill.description: Request job cancellation; returns immediately, settles as killed when work stops.

parameters.reason: Optional reason, logged and forwarded to the job.
